mirror_contract.rule: The repository is the only semantic and versioning source; the live website download surface mirrors only current portable generations.
update_procedure: Update the canonical current portable in Moon-Source first.
Copy the exact canonical UTF-8 bytes to the mapped current LUAHELENA moonsource/downloads path on a branch.
Remove any superseded mirror file from the live website download tree.
Run scripts/check_mirror_sync.py against the remote mirror or a local LUAHELENA checkout.
Open and review a website pull request; merge only after SHA-256 equality and production-surface review.
mirror_contract.current_rebase_note: Preflight version 2.0, Be My Eyes version 1.0-public and Connected Sources version 1.0-public are current standalone portables. Be My Eyes is projected from docs/BE_MY_EYES.md and Connected Sources from docs/CONNECTED_SOURCES.md; their current mirrors are moonsource/downloads/BE_MY_EYES.md and moonsource/downloads/CONNECTED_SOURCES.md. The former docs/PREFLIGHT.md component body is superseded by a succession pointer, while Preflight is mirrored at moonsource/downloads/PREFLIGHT_V2.md. Moon Source Setup version 3.1 adds a capability-probed persistent-source route without making a connector mandatory. Chat–Work Routing Protocol version 4.4-public is the current canonical routing protocol with connector-aware source transport and the model-neutral Intelligence Distillation Ladder; Moon Source Language remains version 4.3. Superseded portable generations remain recoverable through Git history rather than the live tree.
